map.根据工况条件推荐密封材料与型式，估算使用寿命: From working pressure, temperature, medium and speed, recommend seal material (NBR / FKM / PU) and type (O-ring / Yx-ring / Glyd ring) and estimate seal service life for maintenance planning.
map.寿命估算 L = L₀ × f压力 × f速度 × f温度 × f介质（L₀ 基: Service life estimate L = L0 × f_pressure × f_speed × f_temp × f_medium (L0 baseline 10000 h); reduction factors: P>21MPa ×0.6, P>10MPa ×0.8; v>1m/s ×0.6, v>0.5m/s ×0.8; T>120°C ×0.5, T>80°C ×0.7; water/emulsion medium ×0.8; L ≥8000 good, ≥5000 fair
map.密封件寿命以基准寿命（约 10000 h）为基础，按工况严苛度逐项折减：压力越高: Seal life is based on a baseline life (about 10000 h) and reduced item by item by operating severity: higher pressure, faster speed, higher temperature and poorer medium lubricity all increase the reduction, and combining multiple factors gives the estimated life under multi-factor coupling. Material and type are chosen by service condition — FKM for high temperature or phosphate-ester medium, PU preferred for water/emulsion, and ultra-high-pressure reciprocating ( >40 MPa) needs tandem combined seals with a guide ring to prevent eccentric wear.
map.💡 选型依据：压力分级选型式，温度+介质选材料，速度校核，综合估算寿命: 💡 Selection basis: pressure class selects type, temperature + medium select material, velocity check, overall life estimate
map.NBR 耐温 -30~120℃，FKM 耐温 -20~200℃，PU 耐温 -3: NBR temp range -30~120°C, FKM temp range -20~200°C, PU temp range -30~80°C
map.高温（>150℃）或磷酸酯介质应选 FKM（氟橡胶）: High temperature (>150°C) or phosphate-ester medium should use FKM (fluoroelastomer)
map.高压（>21MPa）往复运动应选 Yx圈+挡圈或格莱圈: High pressure (>21MPa) reciprocating motion should use Yx ring + back-up ring or Glyd ring
map.寿命估算为参考值，实际受润滑、清洁度、行程频率影响: Life estimate is a reference value; actual life is affected by lubrication, cleanliness and stroke frequency
map.📚 深度解析：液压密封件选型与寿命: 📚 In-depth: Hydraulic Seal Selection and Life
map.按压力、速度与介质选密封型式。: Select seal type by pressure, speed and medium.
map.高温与污染对寿命的折减。: Reduction of life by high temperature and contamination.
map.设计行程 0.5 m、节拍 60 次/min → 30 m/min；若额定 50: Design stroke 0.5 m, cycle 60 strokes/min → 30 m/min; if rated life 500 km ≈ 278 h, set replacement interval by operating hours.
map.清洁度降级一档，寿命可能减半，故密封与过滤要配套设计。: One grade drop in cleanliness can halve life, so seals and filtration must be designed together.
map.厂商给额定往复里程或小时，结合实际压力速度介质折算。: Manufacturers give rated reciprocating mileage or hours; convert using actual pressure, speed and medium.
map.为什么与清洁度相关？: Why does it relate to cleanliness?
map.颗粒划伤密封面导致泄漏，故 ISO 等级直接影响寿命。: Particles scratch the seal surface and cause leakage, so the ISO grade directly affects life.
map.液压密封件选型工具根据工作压力、温度、介质和运动速度等工况条件，智能推荐密封材料: The hydraulic seal selection tool uses operating conditions such as working pressure, temperature, medium and speed to intelligently recommend seal materials (NBR/FKM/PU) and seal types (O-ring/Yx-ring/Glyd ring, etc.), and comprehensively evaluates operating severity to estimate seal service life; it is an aid for seal design and maintenance of hydraulic systems.
